Stakeholders' Summary (A/HRC/WG.6/53/GRC/3), para. 29 — JS5: "LGBTIQ+ individuals in Greece continued to experience discrimination, harassment, and an alarming escalation in hate-motivated violence"

UN Compilation (A/HRC/WG.6/53/GRC/2), para. 53 — Human Rights Committee: "remained gravely concerned about pushbacks of asylum-seekers, refugees and migrants at the country’s sea and land borders, in violation of the principle of non-refoulement"

action_summary: Reception and living conditions of asylum seekers
grade_label: Partially implemented / steps taken, further action needed
text: Implement immediate measures for asylum seekers, especially in the face of a probable increase in the flow of migrants and asylum seekers from Afghanistan
rationale: Greece operates a modernised reception system (RIC, CCAC, Safe Areas, Hippocrates programme); the Human Rights Committee and CPT still request improved detention and reception conditions.
evidence_quotes: National Report (A/HRC/WG.6/53/GRC/1), para. 46 — Greece: "Eight designated Safe Areas, supported by child protection personnel from NGOs and IOM"

action_summary: Protect refugees and migrants in accordance with international law
grade_label: Not implemented / no relevant action taken
text: Ensure that the necessary legal framework governing NGOs operating in Greece does not inhibit their capacity to contribute to the protection of refugees and migrants (Ireland).
rationale: The Human Rights Committee remains gravely concerned about pushbacks and Greece suspended asylum registration in 2025.
evidence_quotes: UN Compilation (A/HRC/WG.6/53/GRC/2), para. 53 — Human Rights Committee: "remained gravely concerned about pushbacks"
